# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 platform release** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous readback, and broad native reliability fixes. It expands Vulkan support, improves Apple and Android symbol packages, fixes native object lifetime bugs, and reduces allocations in core and HarfBuzzSharp APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia m152** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152, including the m152 servicing and GlyphData stability updates. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU and asynchronous readback APIs** — Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs on SKImage and SKSurface. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native lifetime management corrected** — Fixes use-after-free risks in SKRegion iterators and SKPixmap subsets, an SKImage raster failure buffer leak, and an undisposed stream asset conversion. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Runtime effect, data, and shaping paths allocate less** — Improves uniform lookup construction and reset behavior, avoids redundant data copies, and removes defensive HarfBuzz feature-array copies and tag boxing. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Native package and Vulkan support expanded** — Restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, adds platform symbol-package support, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font handling. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

HarfBuzzSharp reduces shaping allocations and is synchronized with the m152 platform release.
